title: Oil Flask
summary: Throw to spread a flammable Oil surface. It has no barrel-style blast.

fields.Throw: Action, up to 60 ft, creates Oil in a 10 ft radius. There is no direct explosion damage.
fields.Ignition: Fire transforms the Oil into a Fire surface. Destroying the flask with Fire creates a smaller surface than throwing the flask. Oil itself does not slow movement. The Fire surface deals 1d4 Fire per turn and applies Burning for 1 turn.
fields.Base value: 7 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
